clipboard.description: Where y copies: auto (the terminal, via OSC 52, and the system clipboard command when there is one), osc52 (the terminal only), system (pbcopy, wl-copy, xclip, xsel or clip.exe only), off. Default auto.

max_bytes.description: Largest copy, in bytes: terminals cap what OSC 52 carries. Past it nothing is copied and the flash says so. At least 1. Default 1048576.

key_bar.description: Key bar at the bottom. Default compact.

keymap.description: Action name to keys, replacing the default keys of that action, e.g. {follow: [f, ctrl+l]}.

log_columns.description: Columns shown when a logs screen opens: pod and names of layout columns. Empty: every visible column, narrowed automatically.

mouse.description: Huginn reads the mouse: wheel scrolling, click to move the cursor, shift+click and drag to select lines. false leaves the mouse to the terminal, whose own selection then works directly. Default true.

paint_background.description: Paint the theme background instead of using the terminal's.

redact.description: Go regular expressions whose matches become [redacted] in everything copied or saved (not on screen), e.g. ['(?i)bearer [a-z0-9._-]+']. None by default.

save.description: Saving log lines to a file (ctrl+s).

dir.description: Directory of saved files; it must exist. ~ is the home directory. Default: the current directory.

theme.description: Color theme. auto picks light or dark from the terminal's background (asked to the terminal, else COLORFGBG, else dark). Default auto.

usage.description: The resource usage screen (u): CPU and memory per namespace and service, read from the Metrics API (metrics-server).

enabled.description: false removes the usage screen and its key, and nothing is read from the Metrics API. Default true.

history.description: How far back the TREND column reaches, a Go duration kept in memory only while the screen is open, e.g. 30m; 0s keeps none (no TREND). Default 15m.

refresh.description: How often the metrics are read while the usage screen is open, a Go duration of at least 5s, e.g. 30s. One read per namespace each time. Default 15s.

thresholds.description: Where a share of a limit is shown as a warning and as critical.

crit.description: Percentage of a limit from which a value is shown as critical, up to 100. Default 95.

warn.description: Percentage of a limit from which a value is shown as a warning, 1 to 100 and below crit. Default 80.

version.description: Structure version of this file; must be 1.
